svg.title: Nexus toolchain and implement-epic.sh workflow
svg.desc: A 1900 by 1200 flowchart from setup through epic, decision record, implementation, analysis, close and distill. Four cards detail the implementation script: implement stories, publish a draft pull request, run local analyze and fix rounds, and certify the pull request.
svg.text: From intent to verified delivery to durable knowledge
